title: PCAP triage with tshark/Wireshark
steps: `capinfos capture.pcap` and `tshark -r capture.pcap -q -z io,phs` for protocols and volume.
`tshark -r capture.pcap -Y http -T fields -e http.host -e http.request.uri`; export objects with `--export-objects http,out`.
Find the relevant conversation with `-z conv,tcp`; follow it with `-z follow,tcp,ascii,<stream>`.
Check DNS/TLS metadata, credentials in FTP/POP/SMTP, and unusual ports; carve files from streams if needed.
falsifier: The capture is fully encrypted and no keys/metadata are present; protocol analysis alone will not recover plaintext.
